ledger.text: Nadia: The army burns its dead behind the animal houses. Burns most of them.
Soldier: We found bodies in the feed store. They were supposed to be ashes.
Nadia: Stay on the path. They're nervous tonight — so are we.
Soldier: Heavy weapons stay at the armory. Rules of the sanctuary. You keep small arms, the axe, the shotgun, the MG.
Nadia: Gates are locked. We’re safe in here.
Major Hale (radio): They’re in the enclosures!
Rocket launcher handed over to the armory.

phases.label: escape: Lead the group to the armored vehicle
